text:
Priya (CS): Quick runbook request for tenant 'cedar-labs' going live 10:00 PT. Need a 6-item CSM checklist (<10m) that covers prefill probes, warm-pool, jitter/retry, batching guidance, streaming fallback, and a single renewal_risk field. Include copy/paste snippets and one tiny node client.
Ashwin (Solutions): I'll keep it crisp. Suggest we make renewal_risk deterministic: low/medium/high based on clear signal buckets so CSMs don't guess.
Priya (CS): Yes please — CSMs want a single card they can read in 30s. Also require survey_sent and negative_feedback_count in telemetry.
Nora (SRE): I'll own infra checks. Proposed 6-step playbook: 1) Verify health: `GET /healthz?tenant=cedar-labs` -> 200. 2) Run 3 distinct prefill probes (use snippets). 3) Enable warm-pool for 30m. 4) Start staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% (10m intervals). 5) Monitor P95 latency, 1h error rate, and usage delta. 6) Send post-launch survey at +2h.
Dina (PM): For renewal_risk mapping (single field `renewal_risk`): HIGH if any true -> 7d P95 > 420ms OR 1h error_rate > 1.2% OR negative_feedback_count >=1 within 48h. MEDIUM if one marginal threshold (e.g., P95 between 350-420ms) OR small but sustained usage drop (15-30%). LOW otherwise. cs-bot should DM CSM on MEDIUM+ with suggested play actions.
Ashwin (Solutions): Prefill curl (copy/paste):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\
  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: 1' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"tenant":"cedar-labs","samples":["Hi, show my project status","Search: latest deploy"]}'
```
Ashwin (Solutions): Note for customers: "Limit prefill per end-user to 750 tokens and mark samples with \"env\":\"staging\" or \"prod\"."
Nora (SRE): Jitter & retry policy (recommendation): base_backoff=120ms, jitter=random(0..180ms), max_retries=3. Pseudo: `sleep(base + rand(0,180)/1000)` between attempts. Health probe requirement: each prefill probe must return 200 within 2s.
Ashwin (Solutions): Batching quick guidance:
- Interactive UI/chat paths: target batch_size 4, tail_latency_target=50ms, allow up to 8.
- Server-side async jobs: batch 24-64.
- If P95 latency spikes, flip to emergency small-batch mode: batch_size=2 + kv_cache_reuse=true.
Priya (CS): Streaming fallback rule? CSMs want to know app behavior so they can explain to customers.
Nora (SRE): Prefer chunked streaming in prod. If a streaming connection fails or client aborts within the first 6s, automatically retry the request as a sync generate with `max_tokens=220` and header `X-Redwood-Fallback: stream->sync`. Emit telemetry event `fallback_type=stream_to_sync` with `fallback_reason` (e.g., connection_reset).
Ashwin (Solutions): Minimal Node drop-in for prefill that CSMs can paste into docs:```js
const fetch = require('node-fetch');
async function prefill(tenant, samples, key){
  const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${key}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Redwood-Prefill': '1' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ tenant, samples })
  });
  return res.json();
}
// usage: prefill('cedar-labs',['hi','show me my tokens'], process.env.KEY)
```
Dina (PM): Telemetry schema we recommend (single-line JSON event to log in app/backend):
{"event":"prefill_probe","tenant":"cedar-labs","renewal_risk":"low","prefill_tokens":"56","latency_ms":"132","survey_sent":"false","negative_feedback_count":"0"}
Priya (CS): Important: include `survey_sent:true/false` and `negative_feedback_count` so we can automate follow-ups. Also add `model_variant` and `fallback_type` when applicable.
Nora (SRE): Ownership TL;DR (one-line each): CSM = runbook executor & survey follow-up; Solutions = snippets + batching recommendations; SRE = healthchecks, jitter/retry, fallback rules & cs-bot alerts; PM = renewal_risk thresholds, dashboard card, and feedback mapping.
Priya (CS): CSM one-pager (6 checkboxes) to paste in kickoff email: 
- [ ] Confirm `GET /healthz?tenant=cedar-labs` -> 200
- [ ] Run 3 prefill probes (use curl/node snippets) and confirm <2s responses
- [ ] Enable warm-pool for 30m
- [ ] Ramp traffic: 10% -> 40% -> 100% in 10m steps
- [ ] Monitor: P95 latency (7d baseline), 1h error rate, usage delta; open incident if thresholds hit
- [ ] Send post-launch survey at +2h and log `survey_sent=true`
Ashwin (Solutions): Quick note for high-scale customers: if traffic is bursty, prefer prefix/KV caching and set an aggressive batcher for async pipelines to lower unit cost.
Dina (PM): I'll wire the dashboard rule to compute renewal_risk and POST to `/cs/webhook` for MEDIUM+ so CSMs get action items.
cs-bot: Alert rule created -> will DM @Priya when `renewal_risk != low`. :bell:
Priya (CS): Thanks team  I'll paste the one-pager & snippets into the kickoff email once you drop the docs link. Ping me if anything missing. :white_check_mark:
